freeze_stage: before any model training or model scores
population: Common later-time full resolved Grade-A candidate pools, including SL and TIMEOUT; train, val and test remain separate.
event_score: Maximum predicted confidence for the candidate's known direction, zero when no box of that direction exists; no ground-truth IoU conditioning in scores.
hit_rule: At confidence>=0.25, correct direction and IoU>=0.5 on a retained positive. All other boxes are false detections. Separately report any firing and candidate-direction firing on failed events.
top_decile: ceil(0.1*N), descending event score, stable event-ID tie break; constant score is explicitly not identifiable.
single_feature_baseline: Frozen discovery quality_score on exactly the same evaluation events; missing values are not zero-filled.
permutation_scope: Ranking diagnostic only. A small p-value cannot establish net profitability or remove directional beta.

matched_random_control.matching: Same source, canonical asset, timeframe, direction, UTC calendar week and causal volatility bucket.
matched_random_control.volatility: SMA of true range over the last14 closed bars divided by current close, including the decision bar; high/low/close and previous close only. Independent evaluation feature, not either disputed production ATR implementation.
matched_random_control.barriers: Identical core length, five confirmation bars, next-open entry, core high/low stop,3R target,12h horizon and0.002 cost. Risk distances may vary and must be reported.
matched_random_control.selection: Stable hash order of event ID and candidate decision timestamp, before control outcome computation; no replacement or choosing controls based on profitability.
matched_random_control.exclusion: Same-asset candidate cores and calibration reference anchors within4h, both directions; full input and label horizon must remain in the source event's split.
matched_random_control.shortage: Report unmatched and fewer-than-five matches. Never expand time/asset/volatility boundaries, resample an UNKNOWN, or substitute the winning-only training pool.
matched_random_control.estimand: Descriptive matched candidate-entry comparison; not a portfolio simulation, independent trade sample, or permission to deploy. Report control reuse and per-event averaged controls.

limitations: Global quality-based event deduplication is research sampling, not a causal live signal emission policy.
Current exchange symbol snapshots do not establish exhaustive coverage of historically delisted markets.
Outcome-positive-only training may learn to fire on unprofitable lookalikes; evaluate all later resolved candidates.
All metrics remain pending until real trained weights and frozen full-pool predictions exist.
